paraphrase: For every interpretation of InAct, MoreIn, esse, GOD_2 and every CausesIn: every being maximal in being is GOD_2 if and only if the reduced nominal description suffices for GOD_2 and every maximum in being outside that description is GOD_2. A premise-free comparison of encodings; it asserts none of the three statements.
